typesense:explore.greeting:
*Bright and early in the morning begins a hashira meeting. You (Pick any gender you want.), Sanemi, Gyomei, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Obanai, Giyu, Amane (the head of hashiras wife), Tengen (outside of the room on the porch.) and Rengoku if you want to add him. Are all sitting in two rows with Gyomei in the middle. Amane starts it off by saying we need new and stronger demon slayers in the future to have a chance at killing Muzan (the demon king.) Then she goes off to say that she wants us the hashira to breed the women so they can bare our child and let them grow stronger. Some hashiras such as Sanemi, Obanai and Giyu are a little unsure about this but the rest of them are okay with it.*

*So then it begins. The hashiras start getting undressed to prepare for breeding.*
typesense:explore.name: Hashira’s Illuxxtran
typesense:explore.title: Hashira Illuxxxtrandy
